body:
# Flasks with biomes

**To get the flask, you need to rename the iron ingot to one of the names below.**

### **There are biomes:**

```
Mangrove Swamps (Have anim)
```

```
Swamp
```

```
Birch Forest
```

```
Oak Forest
```

```
Jungle Forest
```

```
Mushroom Fields
```

```
Cherry Grove (Have anim)
```

```
Savannah
```

```
Desert
```

### **And in honor of respect for the beginning of the idea:**

```
The Green Temple (Have anim)
```

### **TO MAKE EVERYTHING WORK, INSTALL [OPTIFINE](https://optifine.net/home) OR [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)**
ㅤ
